title: Trapped in Syria, Part 2: A Plea to Parliament

sentences.en: All of a sudden, US troops left their observation posts along the Syrian border after the White House said it wouldn't stand in the way of a Turkish invasion.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，在白宫表示不会阻挠土耳其入侵后，美军撤离了他们在叙利亚边境沿线的观察哨。

sentences.en: Turkey has confirmed that its ground forces are on the move after launching an aerial attack overnight.
sentences.zh: 土耳其证实，在夜间发动空袭后，其地面部队正在推进。

sentences.en: It comes after the abrupt US pullout from the area.
sentences.zh: 此前，美军从该地区突然撤离。

sentences.en: Turkey has released a video of its fighter jets bombing Kurdish positions as the nation presses ahead with its invasion.

sentences.en: The best time to get these 66 women and children out of the Al-Hul camp was before the Turkish invasion.
sentences.zh: 将这66名妇女和儿童从霍尔营地接出来的最佳时机是在土耳其入侵之前。

sentences.en: The government had little appetite, I must say, to get these people out of Syria before the invasion.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，政府在入侵前将这些人接出叙利亚的意愿并不高。

sentences.en: I don't detect a great appetite now.

sentences.en: And it's certainly now a lot more complicated.

sentences.en: Now, their future looks really, really uncertain.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们的未来看起来真的非常非常不确定。

sentences.en: And if they do get out, perhaps...

sentences.en: Yesterday on The Daily, we met Kamal Debussy, who for months has been lobbying the Australian government to bring back his daughter and grandchildren,
sentences.zh: 昨天在《每日晨报》节目中，我们采访了卡马尔·德布西，几个月来他一直在游说澳大利亚政府接回他的女儿和孙辈，

sentences.en: who are being held at a detention center in Syria for the relatives of ISIS fighters.
sentences.zh: 他们被关押在叙利亚的一个拘留中心里，里面关押着ISIS武装分子的家属。

sentences.en: When we left off, Kamal had just received a call from a journalist that President Trump had just announced he would withdraw US troops from the Syrian border.
sentences.zh: 在我们上次采访时，卡马尔刚刚接到一名记者的电话，称特朗普总统刚刚宣布他将从叙利亚边境撤出美军。

sentences.en: And it was expected that the Kurdish forces who had been guarding the prisons as allies of the US would abandon their posts, leaving the prisoners' lives in imminent danger.
sentences.zh: 人们预计，作为美国盟友一直守卫监狱的库尔德武装将放弃阵地，使囚犯的生命面临迫在眉睫的危险。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Livia Albeck-Ripka follows Kamal's journey to convince the Australian government that that danger is greater than the one posed by bringing his daughter home.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事莉维亚·阿尔贝克-里普卡跟随卡马尔展开行程，说服澳大利亚政府相信，这种危险比接他女儿回国所带来的危险要大。

sentences.en: He gathers his thoughts, and then he pretty much immediately springs into action.

sentences.en: And the women fear the worst, that its troops could take over the camp, raping them, turning them into slaves, or worse.
sentences.zh: 女人们感到最糟糕的情况可能会发生，那就是政府军可能会接管营地，强暴她们，把她们变成奴隶，或者更糟。

sentences.en: Hi, this is an Australian in the camps.
sentences.zh: 嗨，这是一个身处营地中的澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: We just got news that the Kurds have allied with the regime.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚得到消息，库尔德人已经与政权结盟了。

sentences.en: The women are sending Kamal frantic voice memos from the camp.
sentences.zh: 女人们正从营地给卡马尔（Kamal）发来一条条焦急的语音备忘录。

sentences.en: One of their deals is to give us women ISIS prisoners and women and children from the camps and to transfer us to botch that and to transfer us to Damascus.
sentences.zh: 他们的交易之一就是把我们这些身为ISIS囚犯的女人们以及营地里的妇孺交给他们，并将我们转移去……把我们转移到大马士革。

sentences.en: This is not...
sentences.zh: 这不……

sentences.en: This is not what we deserve.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们应得的。

sentences.en: We're scared.
sentences.zh: 我们很害怕。

sentences.en: We need help.
sentences.zh: 我们需要帮助。

sentences.en: We really need urgent help.
sentences.zh: 我们真的需要紧急帮助。

sentences.en: The majority of these kids are little babies.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子大多都是小婴儿。

sentences.en: We don't want them to be raised in regime prisons.
sentences.zh: 我们不想让他们在政权的监狱里长大。

sentences.en: At least our kids.
sentences.zh: 至少为了我们的孩子。

sentences.en: At least our children.
sentences.zh: 至少为了我们的孩子们。

sentences.en: They don't deserve to see this.
sentences.zh: 他们不该看到这些。

sentences.en: They don't deserve to see this.
sentences.zh: 他们不该经历这些。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 求求你们。

sentences.en: Please, please.
sentences.zh: 求求你们，求求你们。

sentences.en: Before it's too late.
sentences.zh: 在为时已晚之前。

sentences.en: Within the next few days, this is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 就在接下来几天内，这件事就要发生了。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 求求你们。

sentences.en: Please help us.
sentences.zh: 请帮帮我们。

sentences.en: I know nobody can really come here and help us, but somebody needs to say something.
sentences.zh: 我知道没有人能真正来到这里帮助我们，但总得有人发声。

sentences.en: Somebody needs to do something.
sentences.zh: 总得有人做点什么。

sentences.en: I don't want to be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 我不想被遗忘。

sentences.en: I don't want to be ignored from the world.
sentences.zh: 我不想被世界忽视。

sentences.en: I don't want my kids to be ignored from the world.
sentences.zh: 我不想我的孩子们被世界忽视。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 求求你们。

sentences.en: Please, please.
sentences.zh: 求求你们，求求你们。

sentences.en: Please just save us from here.
sentences.zh: 求求你们把我们从这里救出去吧。

sentences.en: The Kurds did a deal with the Syrian government to fend off a Turkish offensive.
sentences.zh: 库尔德人为了抵御土耳其的进攻，与叙利亚政府达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: They say they had to choose between compromise and genocide.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们只能在妥协和种族灭绝之间做出选择。

sentences.en: The next day, we wake up to the news that the Kurds have formed a deal with Syria.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早醒来，我们就听到了库尔德人与叙利亚达成协议的消息。

sentences.en: 200,000 people have fled their homes.
sentences.zh: 二十万人流离失所。

sentences.en: Which, for Kamal, is a horrendous thought.
sentences.zh: 对卡马尔来说，这是一个可怕的想法。

sentences.en: He thinks that if the Syrians take over the camps, the women are as good as dead.
sentences.zh: 他认为，如果叙利亚人接管了营地，女人们就跟死人差不多了。

sentences.en: In fact, he says death would be the more merciful option.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他说死亡反而是更仁慈的选择。

sentences.en: So, when Kamal shows up in Parliament that day, he is on a mission.
sentences.zh: 因此，当卡马尔那天出现在议会时，他肩负着使命。

sentences.en: We're just walking through the press gallery in Canberra in Parliament.
sentences.zh: 我们正走在堪培拉议会的记者席里。

sentences.en: You can see all the different national media outlets.
sentences.zh: 你能看到所有不同的国家媒体机构。

sentences.en: Channel 10, ABC, SBS.
sentences.zh: 第十频道，ABC，SBS。

sentences.en: We're heading into an interview where Kamal is going to be interviewed by Channel 7.
sentences.zh: 我们正前往一个采访地点，卡马尔将在那里接受第七频道的采访。

sentences.en: There you go, guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位。

sentences.en: You should be able to hear each other.
sentences.zh: 你们应该能听到彼此的声音了。

sentences.en: Hello there.
sentences.zh: 你好啊。

sentences.en: Hi, Sam.
sentences.zh: 嗨，萨姆。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right, yes.
sentences.zh: 对，没错，是的。

sentences.en: Hi, Kamal.
sentences.zh: 嗨，卡马尔。

sentences.en: It's Ray from Channel 7.
sentences.zh: 我是第七频道的雷。

sentences.en: How are you going?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm good, thank you, Ray.
sentences.zh: 我很好，谢谢你，雷。

sentences.en: That's good.
sentences.zh: 那就好。

sentences.en: I just, obviously, this story is huge.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，显然这个故事太重大了。

sentences.en: Media are asking him the same questions over and over again.
sentences.zh: 媒体一直在向他反复问着同样的问题。

sentences.en: And what's her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Mariam.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安（Mariam）。

sentences.en: Mariam Dabusi.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安·达布西（Mariam Dabusi）。

sentences.en: Obviously, now it's getting very violent.
sentences.zh: 显然，现在局势变得非常暴力。

sentences.en: What's your message?
sentences.zh: 你想传达的信息是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's not only from...
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不仅来自于……

sentences.en: As Kamal gives these interviews, over and over and over and over.
sentences.zh: 随着卡马尔一次又一次、不厌其烦地接受这些采访。

sentences.en: He is actually wearing down.
sentences.zh: 他其实已经精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: He's getting sick.
sentences.zh: 他开始生病了。

sentences.en: But he can't let himself stop.
sentences.zh: 但他不能让自己停下来。

sentences.en: He'll talk to anybody.
sentences.zh: 他会跟任何人对话。

sentences.en: Have you managed to speak to your daughter, well, sister?
sentences.zh: 你设法联系上你女儿……呃，妹妹了吗？

sentences.en: We've had sporadic contact.
sentences.zh: 我们有过零星的联系。

sentences.en: Phones are a difficult issue, but there are some central places where you can buy time.
sentences.zh: 手机是个棘手的问题，但有一些集中点可以买到通话时间。

sentences.en: But, of course, the real reason that Kamal came here is to talk to the politicians, the lawmakers, who will ultimately decide the fate of these women and children.
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，卡马尔来这里的真正原因是为了与政客、立法者对话，他们将最终决定这些妇女和儿童的命运。

sentences.en: And so he has meetings lined up with any of them who will listen.
sentences.zh: 因此，他安排了与任何愿意倾听他们的政客的会面。

sentences.en: Heading on in to speak with Christina Keneally, who's the Shadow Minister of Home Affairs.
sentences.zh: 正前往与内政事务影子部长克里斯蒂娜·肯尼利（Christina Keneally）进行交谈。

sentences.en: Hi, guys.
sentences.zh: 嗨，各位。

sentences.en: Just knocking on the door now.
sentences.zh: 现在正敲门呢。

sentences.en: Here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们到了。

sentences.en: Thanks, Kamal.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，卡马尔。

sentences.en: So that one might be ours.
sentences.zh: 所以那个可能是我们的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Catch you later.
sentences.zh: 回头见。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Do you think it's Mr. Chancellor?
sentences.zh: 你觉得是钱勒（Chancellor）先生吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Not this one.
sentences.zh: 不是这个。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: No, this one might be.
sentences.zh: 不，这个可能是。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I know that.
sentences.zh: 我知道那个。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Catch you afterwards.
sentences.zh: 结束后见。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you, man.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你，伙计。

sentences.en: I'm following him as best I can, but a lot of it is behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 我尽我所能地跟着他，但很多事情都是在闭门会议中进行的。

sentences.en: And from what you can tell, what's the reception that Kamal is getting?
sentences.zh: 据你所见，卡马尔受到的接待怎么样？

sentences.en: It's not a very favorable one.
sentences.zh: 算不上非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: Australia has a conservative government, and a lot of the comments that these lawmakers are making indicate that they are really opposed to bringing these women home.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚拥有一个保守派政府，这些立法者发表的许多言论表明，他们非常反对把这些女人接回家。

sentences.en: There's one man in particular, the Home Affairs Minister, Peter Dutton, who is especially outspoken.
sentences.zh: 特别是有一个人，内政部长彼得·达顿（Peter Dutton），态度尤为直言不讳。

sentences.en: He's saying things like, based on the evidence that he has received, some of these women could be capable of making bombs or even unleashing what he describes as a mass casualty.
sentences.zh: 他说，根据他收到的证据，其中一些女人可能具备制造炸弹的能力，甚至会发动他所描述的大规模伤亡事件。

sentences.en: Kamal says that, based on what he knows of these women, they weren't fighters.
sentences.zh: 卡马尔则表示，根据他对这些女人的了解，她们并不是战斗人员。

sentences.en: He describes them as baby-making machines.
sentences.zh: 他形容她们是生孩子机器。

sentences.en: He talks about this one girl in particular who went into Syria at 15, and by 19, she has three children.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了其中一个特别的女孩，15岁时进入叙利亚，到19岁时已经有了三个孩子。

sentences.en: So, this leads him to believe that, you know, it's very possible a lot of these women were coerced.
sentences.zh: 因此，这让他相信，你知道的，很多女人极有可能是被胁迫的。

sentences.en: They were forced.
sentences.zh: 她们是被迫的。

sentences.en: Including his own daughter.
sentences.zh: 包括他自己的女儿在内。

sentences.en: In all the years that Mariam was with ISIS, Kamal didn't quite know what to think about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽安加入ISIS的所有年头里，卡马尔并不太清楚发生的事情究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: About how much had been her own choice.
sentences.zh: 不清楚其中有多少是她自己的选择。

sentences.en: But that day in the camp, when he sees her after all that time, he finally gets to ask her.
sentences.zh: 但在营地的那个日子里，在经历了这一切之后再次见到她，他终于有机会问她了。

sentences.en: And she told him a story.
sentences.zh: 而她向他讲述了一个故事。

sentences.en: That when she and her husband, Khaled, had gone to Turkey to stay with his family back in 2015, that after a few months, he told her and the rest of the family that they needed
sentences.zh: 早在2015年，当她和丈夫哈立德（Khaled）前往土耳其与他的家人居住时，几个月后，他告诉她和家里的其他人，他们需要

sentences.en: to go to the Syrian border to rescue a relative who had joined ISIS, but now wanted out.
sentences.zh: 前往叙利亚边境去营救一位曾经加入ISIS但现在想要脱身的亲戚。

sentences.en: And Mariam says, when they get there, all of a sudden, gunshots are ringing into the air, everybody's running, there's mayhem.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安说，当他们到达那里时，突然枪声四起，每个人都在奔跑，一片混乱。

sentences.en: And then she's forced at gunpoint with her child into a car, which takes them across the border into Syria.
sentences.zh: 然后她和孩子在枪口威胁下被迫坐上一辆车，车子把他们载过了边境进入叙利亚。

sentences.en: And it's not until Mariam sees this ISIS flag flying from this halfway house that she understands what has happened to her.
sentences.zh: 直到玛丽安看到这面ISIS旗帜从这个临时收容所飘扬起来时，她才明白自己遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: And Kamal believes his daughter.
sentences.zh: 而卡马尔选择相信他的女儿。

sentences.en: Do you think that, do you see Mariam in this purely as a victim or do you think she may have made some choices herself?
sentences.zh: 你认为，你觉得玛丽安纯粹是个受害者，还是认为她自己可能也做出过一些选择？

sentences.en: Mariam's choices have been to survive.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安的选择一直都是为了生存。

sentences.en: I see her purely as a victim and everything that comes from then has been just to survive.
sentences.zh: 我纯粹把她视为受害者，自那以后发生的一切都只是为了活下去。

sentences.en: I don't see her as a perpetrator at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不觉得她是个施害者。

sentences.en: She is a victim and any decision she's made has been solely to survive and for the best interests of her kids.
sentences.zh: 她是一个受害者，她做出的任何决定都完全是为了生存，为了她孩子的最大利益。

sentences.en: And I firmly believe that.
sentences.zh: 我对此坚信不疑。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to belabor this point, but I have to ask, you know, these women are Australian women.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉反复纠结这一点，但我不得不问，你知道的，这些女性都是澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: They grew up in a Western country with Western values.
sentences.zh: 她们在西方国家成长，拥有西方价值观。

sentences.en: And the idea that they were forced, tricked, duped, that they had no agency whatsoever, I can see why that might be a hard pill for some people in the Australian public to swallow.
sentences.zh: 那种认为她们是被迫的、被哄骗的、被愚弄的，认为她们完全没有自主权的说法，我可以理解为什么澳大利亚公众中的某些人会觉得很难接受。

sentences.en: Because what does that say about women?
sentences.zh: 因为这说明了女性的什么问题？

sentences.en: From the Australian context, I think if you are raised as an Anglo in Anglo communities for most of your life, one might say, I find this hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 从澳大利亚的背景来看，我想如果你大半生都在盎格鲁社区里作为盎格鲁人抚养长大，有人可能会说，我觉得这很难相信。

sentences.en: But then I've also had people come and tell me, you know, if my husband said, let's go for a holiday or my husband told me we're going to go and do this great humanitarian act
sentences.zh: 但我也遇到过有人对我说，你知道的，如果我丈夫说，我们去度个假，或者我丈夫告诉我我们要去进行一次伟大的仁爱行动

sentences.en: of trying to save a family member from a terrible regime, I would be there backing him up 100% and I would be supporting him all the way.
sentences.zh: 去把一个家庭成员从一个可怕的政权手中解救出来，我会百分之百地支持他，我会一路支持他到底。

sentences.en: So I do get a mixture of views from the public to say that putting myself in those shoes, in Mariam's shoes, they actually would have supported their husband.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实从公众那里听到了各种各样的观点，他们说如果设身处地为他们着想，为玛丽姆着想，他们其实会支持自己的丈夫。

sentences.en: And most of the women that made those choices to go went because they were trying to protect their family unit.
sentences.zh: 大多数做出那些离开的选择的女性，走是因为她们试图保护自己的家庭单位。

sentences.en: And culturally, this is raised as the most important thing in your life, your family, your family, your family, you do whatever you can to save your family unit.
sentences.zh: 在文化上，这被认为是生命中最重要的事情：你的家庭，你的家庭，你的家庭，你尽一切努力去拯救你的家庭单位。

sentences.en: And that is the sort of the number one cultural value that persists within the Muslim community is that family unit is so important.
sentences.zh: 这是穆斯林社区中持续存在的首要文化价值观，那就是家庭单位是如此重要。

sentences.en: So even if your husband's made a mistake, you still support your husband, even if he's made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使你丈夫犯了错，你仍然支持你丈夫，即使他犯了错。

sentences.en: And that's the culture that women raised in predominantly.
sentences.zh: 这就是女性主要成长于其中的文化。

sentences.en: But you didn't raise Mariam like that.
sentences.zh: 但你并不是这样抚养玛丽姆的。

sentences.en: No, that's why you had to trick her to go across the border.
sentences.zh: 不，这就是为什么你得骗她过境。

sentences.en: Well, Mariam would never have agreed to that, but she wanted family.
sentences.zh: 嗯，玛丽姆绝不会同意那样做，但她渴望家庭。

sentences.en: So she probably, you know, would have, even if she'd had a warning sign, she probably would have dismissed it in her brain because she actually wanted family so much as well.
sentences.zh: 所以她可能，你知道的，即使她注意到了警告信号，她可能也会在脑海中将其忽视，因为她其实同样非常渴望家庭。

sentences.en: So yes, she was independent and yes, she was stubborn and she was fiery and she was feisty, but, or let's say lively, is lively.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，她是独立的，是的，她是固执的，她是火爆的，她是很有冲劲的，或者我们说充满活力，确实充满活力。

sentences.en: Um, but, but, but I, you know, I think if she had any doubts until it was something concrete, she would have just been dismissive because she wanted family so much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是，但是，但是我认为，如果她有任何疑虑，直到事情变得具体之前，她都会不以为然，因为她太渴望家庭了。

sentences.en: So you think maybe that there were red flags for her and she pushed them away because to me.
sentences.zh: 所以你认为对她来说也许曾有红线警示，而她把它们推开了，因为对我来说。

sentences.en: I think potentially, I mean, I think to myself, even if there were some smaller red, like, as there were.
sentences.zh: 我认为有可能，我的意思是，我在想，即使有一些较小的红线，就像确实存在的那样。

sentences.en: You know, I think that despite Kamal's unwavering belief in his own daughter's story, he does understand.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认为尽管卡迈尔对亲生女儿的说法深信不疑，他确实理解。

sentences.en: He understands why people might be afraid for these women to come home.
sentences.zh: 他理解为什么人们可能会害怕这些女性回家。

sentences.en: But he also kind of says, that's not the point.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也表示，重点不在这里。

sentences.en: The bigger point here is we don't know these women's culpability.
sentences.zh: 这里更大的重点是，我们并不清楚这些女性的罪责。

sentences.en: So he says, let's bring them back and let's have due process applied before we turn our backs on these women, assuming that they're guilty.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，让我们把她们带回来，在我们在假设她们有罪而对她们置之不理之前，先走正当的法律程序。

sentences.en: He says, this is what a country like Australia actually owes its citizens, whether they're guilty or not guilty.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是一个像澳大利亚这样的国家实际上对它的公民所负有的责任，无论他们有罪还是无罪。

sentences.en: And right now we just don't know.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们只是还不知道。

sentences.en: Basically what he's saying is there are dangers, yes, with repatriating people, but there are also dangers with not.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，遣返人员确实存在危险，但拒绝遣返同样存在危险。

sentences.en: And that's why he's in Canberra, fighting for their right to come home.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他在堪培拉，为她们回家的权利而战。

sentences.en: Hi everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你们好吗？

sentences.en: I'm Olivia.
